description: This file defines APIs, callback structures, and macros for Bluetooth Mesh Proxy functionality in Zephyr OS, including enabling proxy identity advertising, managing proxy connections, and scheduling solicitation PDUs.

methods.name: bt_mesh_proxy_identity_enable
methods.description: Enables advertising with Node Identity for the next 60 seconds, requires GATT Proxy support.

methods.name: bt_mesh_proxy_private_identity_enable
methods.description: Enables advertising with Private Node Identity for the next 60 seconds, requires GATT Proxy support.

methods.name: bt_mesh_proxy_connect
methods.description: Allows a proxy client to auto-connect to a network identified by net_idx.

methods.name: bt_mesh_proxy_disconnect
methods.description: Disallows a proxy client from auto-connecting to a network identified by net_idx.

methods.name: bt_mesh_proxy_solicit
methods.description: Schedules advertising of Solicitation PDUs for the specified network.
